architecture.title: How the atlas is built — the READMEs are the only source of truth
architecture.caption: Everything in this module is read from the local clone of NVIDIA's playbooks. Lab 21-1 parses each nvidia/playbook-*/README.md (title, Estimated time, Supported hardware platforms, Prerequisites disk) and joins it with the module table in week25/AUTHORING.md. Labs 21-2 and 21-3 and Exercise 21 import that parser. The lab stays offline: links are built from the directory name and checked against the build.nvidia.com/spark slug index (fetched 2026-09-29, stored in the lab) and against links written in the READMEs.

sequence.title: Lab 21-2 — from a goal in plain words to a cited playbook
sequence.caption: The recommender never calls a model. It tokenizes the goal with the same stopwords as the READMEs, weights each word by how rare it is across the 64 playbooks (IDF), and ranks playbooks by cosine similarity. It prints the words that matched, so you can see why a playbook won — and why a goal worded differently from the README misses (step 3).
